Q5651.reason: An 'as is' clause excludes implied warranties but cannot override an express misrepresentation regarding the fundamental identity of the goods.

Q5672.reason: An insanity acquittal does not preclude a subsequent prosecution because it implies guilt but excuses liability due to mental state, unlike self-defense which negates the crime entirely.

Q8537.reason: The concept must remain value-neutral so that debates about whether punishment is justified can occur without being settled by the definition itself.
